body:
Computer-use agents (CUAs) that confine themselves to pixels pay a heavy tax: a single screenshot consumes thousands of tokens, and re-deriving structured file edits through dozens of mouse clicks discards the fastest, most verifiable channel on the machine.

## Ficha rápida

- microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork
- 4.7B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 3.5 GB (Portátil / GPU 4 GB)
- ~224 tok/s en RTX 4090 (Q4)
- licencia apache-2.0
- 105 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

Mage-VL-Cowork A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use from Evolved Harnesses

One compact 4B policy that knows when to click — and when to code.

Computer-use agents (CUAs) that confine themselves to pixels pay a heavy tax: a single screenshot consumes thousands of tokens, and re-deriving structured file edits through dozens of mouse clicks discards the fastest, most verifiable channel on the machine. Conversely, giving a frontier model naive access to both GUI and terminal tools does not automatically produce hybrid competence — without an optimized execution scaffold, even frontier teachers exhibit suboptimal channel habits that transfer directly to distilled students.

Mage-VL-Cowork bridges this gap. Trained end-to-end from an intermediate 4B Mage-VL checkpoint through a progressive five-stage specialize-then-unify curriculum, it combines screenshot-grounded GUI interaction (computeruse) and persistent code/terminal execution (bash) inside a single vision-language policy — with no external orchestrator.
